name: Weather
description: Current conditions and a daily forecast for any place on Earth, by latitude/longitude — through Open-Meteo, a free API with no key and no account. Ports agentic-workspace's aw-open-meteo MCP into aw-workspace. Pair with aw-google-maps' geocode_address, or a mobile companion app's get_location, to resolve a place name into coordinates first.

skills.description: Current conditions and daily forecast lookups by lat/lon through this app's aw-weather MCP server — which tool answers which question, and how to resolve a place name into coordinates first.

apps.reason: This app ships a static mcp.json (the 'weather' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan weather/mcp.json.
